{{Quote|Hey, care to help out the city for Nym?|Ran Machado, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />}}
'''Ran Machado''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] named [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Nym put Machado in charge of eliminating various kinds of unwanted [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that had grown in and around [[Nym's Stronghold]] and the [[City/Legends|city]] that surrounded it on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. While he supervised the eradication of the weeds, Machado attempted to enlist the help of individuals by enticing them with promises of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and notoriety. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] in charge of the weed pulling in Nym's Stronghold, Machado wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] on his body and a [[Borg Construct Aj^6]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] attached to the back of his head.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Nym has put me in charge of pulling up some of the unintended foliage around the stronghold and city. All you need to do is find weeds, pull them up and dispose of them properly.|Ran Machado, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />}}
[[File:Ran_Machado2-SWG.png|thumb|left|110px|Ran Machado in Nym's Stronghold on Lok]]
Ran Machado was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, during at least part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], served as a member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group led by a [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] pirate known as [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. For at least part of his tenure with the group, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Machado was at [[Nym's Stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], where Nym assigned him the duty of leading an effort to pull up a large number of unwanted [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that had grown up in the stronghold and the surrounding [[City/Legends|city]]. Machado stayed at the entrance of the fortress and tried to entice people who walked by with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and notoriety if they helped him.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Eventually, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] agreed to take care of some of the weeds. Machado gave the spacer a quota of different types of weeds to pull, including [[Paddle cactus|paddle cacti]], [[yellow pod weed]]s, some [[low growing weed]]s, [[tall weed]]s, and [[Flowering cactus|flowering cacti]]. He instructed the spacer to complete the quota and then take the waste to a dumpster located in Nym's Stronghold. When the spacer completed the task and returned to Machado, the pirate paid out 2000 credits for the work along with a small bonus for pulling up extra weeds. However, the task was still not complete after the spacer's quota was complete, so Machado continued to ask for more help.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're back! Want in on more weed pulling?|Ran Machado, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />}}
As of his weed-pulling assignment, Machado was completely bald with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|eyebrows]]. His [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were also brown in color, and he had fair skin. During his work for Nym, Machado celebrated by clapping, raising his [[Limb/Legends|arms]] into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], and shaking them.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />

==Equipment==
[[File:RanMachadoBorgConstructAj6-SWG.png|thumb|right|150px|Ran Machado's Borg Construct Aj^6 cybernetic implant]]
As one of Nym's pirates, Machado had a dark-gray<ref name="SWG:WWFR" /> [[Borg Construct Aj^6]]<ref name="SWGImplant" /> [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implant]] attached to the back of his head, a device that covered his [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. The implant had dark-red and light-blue markings on it, as well as small red lights. He also wore a suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that covered all of his body except for his head. The parts of the armor that covered his upper torso, the upper arms, and the tops of his [[Boot/Legends|boots]] were light-gray in color. However, the parts that covered his lower torso, waist, hands, thighs, some of his lower legs, and the toes of his footwear were a slightly darker shade of gray. He also wore a dark-gray [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on his left shoulder and a belt. His lower arms and most of his lower legs were covered with darker and lighter armor.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Machado had access to equipment that allowed him to communicate with the spacer who pulled weeds for him.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ran Machado first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG online video game]] produced by [[LucasArts]] and [[Sony]] Online Entertainment<ref name="SWG:WWFR" /> that was shut down on [[December]] [[December 15|15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ran Machado was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:WWFR" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>

Ran Machado could be approached by the player to activate a quest that required the player to pull a certain number of various kinds of weeds for completion. Completion of the quest gave the player experience, credits, and a random weed, which was a part of a collection that gave the player a badge when completed. Talking to Ran Machado was the player's choice, so it is not guaranteed that anyone helped him with his weed pulling or even spoke to him at all.<ref name="SWG:WWFR" />

During the quest "[[W:c:swg:Out of My Mine|Out of My Mine]]," the Lok Revenant [[Grenz Zittoun]] incorectly stated that Ran Machado was the Grand Foreman of the [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial Mine]]. It was in fact [[Rel Rogock]].<ref name="SWG:OoMM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Out of My Mine|Lok}}</ref>
